name: Mk2PVRouter Surplus Energy Diverter
description: The `mk2pvrouter` component allows you to retrieve telemetry data from a Mk2PVRouter diverter and to control it via GPIO switches. It works with any Mk2PVRouter diverter, as long as the telemetry feature has been activated on the router itself.
